title: Trigun Stargaze
synopsis:
Two and a half years after the dark day of the Lost JuLai, Meryl Stryfe roams in the desert wilderness of Noman's Land alongside her younger assistant, Milly Thompson. She still pursues Vash the Stampede, the culprit behind the cataclysmic events that took the lives of 90 percent of the JuLai city population. Vash, also referred to as the "Humanoid Typhoon," is now sought after for 60 billion double dollars—the largest bounty in the history of the planet.

In a backwater town of Noman's Land, an apathetic Vash has been rescued and cared for by Hoppered the Gauntlet, a man who covers his mutilated body with armor. But Hoppered's secluded life is abruptly interrupted by the arrival of young Jessica seeking help for her endangered home.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Dos años y medio después del oscuro día de Lost JuLai, Meryl Stryfe deambula por el desierto de Tierra de Nadie junto a su asistente más joven, Milly Thompson. Todavía persigue a Vash the Stampede, el culpable de los catastróficos acontecimientos que acabaron con la vida del 90 por ciento de la población de la ciudad de JuLai. Vash, también conocido como el "Tifón Humanoide", ahora es buscado por 60 mil millones de dólares el doble, la mayor recompensa en la historia del planeta.

En un pueblo apartado de Tierra de Nadie, un apático Vash ha sido rescatado y cuidado por Hoppered the Gauntlet, un hombre que cubre su cuerpo mutilado con una armadura. Pero la vida aislada de Hoppered se ve abruptamente interrumpida por la llegada de la joven Jessica en busca de ayuda para su hogar en peligro.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Wandering Days
episodes_data.description: Two years have passed since the events at JuLai. Vash is still missing. Someone is stealing Plants again.

episodes_data.title: Unforgiven
episodes_data.description: When their home is attacked, Vash is the last hope for Brad, Jessica, and the others.

episodes_data.title: Memento Mori
episodes_data.description: The immediate threat is suppressed, but now there is no doubt that the threat from Knives is still real.

episodes_data.title: From Order to Chaos
episodes_data.description: Vash sets off for Home with his companions, but Knives` men are already planning a new attack.

episodes_data.title: What a Wonderful World
episodes_data.description: Midvalley attacks Home and faces off against Wolfwood.

episodes_data.title: The Darkest Hour Is Just Before the Dawn
episodes_data.description: Everyone prepares for a huge battle as Legato and the Ark approaches Ship 3.
episodes_data.title_es: La hora más oscura es justo antes del amanecer

episodes_data.title: The Hurt Locker
episodes_data.description: As the arrival of the fleet imminent, both factions begin preparations for the final showdown.

episodes_data.title: Good Bye, My Friend
episodes_data.description: Wolfwood helps Vash break out of the Ark, but is pursued by Razlo, Livio`s alter ego.

episodes_data.title: Reunion
episodes_data.description: The crew, with its latest new member Livio, regroup at Hopeland to kick off their plan to stop Knives.

episodes_data.title: Martyr
episodes_data.description: Vash and Knives, and their respective allies, face off in a final showdown at the crash site where it all started.

episodes_data.title: I Miss You.
episodes_data.description: Knives arrives and captures Vash. His final plan is set in motion - as well as Vash`s final resistance.

episodes_data.title: Quo Vadis
episodes_data.description: The immigrant fleet arrives, and Knives single-handedly threatens to eliminate them.

background: Trigun Stargaze was released on Blu-ray by Toho on June 17, 2026.
